Hopfield networks are popular models of associative memory, but they suffer from spurious memories and low efficiency. Here, we present a new model of an associative memory that overcomes these deficiencies. We call this model sparse associative memory (SAM) because it is based on sparse projections from neural patterns to pattern-specific neurons. These sparse projections have been shown to be sufficient to uniquely encode a neural pattern. Based on this principle, we investigate theoretically and in simulation our SAM model, which turns out to have high memory efficiency and a vanishingly small probability of spurious memories. This model may serve as a basic building block of brain functions involving associative memory.","affiliation":"HRL Laboratories, Malibu, CA 90265, U.S.A. hhoffmann@hrl.com.","publicationStatus":"ppublish","language":"eng","pubModel":"Print-Electronic","pubTypeList":{"pubType":["Journal Article"]},"meshHeadingList":{"meshHeading":[{"majorTopic_YN":"N","descriptorName":"Brain","meshQualifierList":{"meshQualifier":[{"majorTopic_YN":"N","abbreviation":"PH","qualifierName":"physiology"}]}},{"majorTopic_YN":"N","descriptorName":"Neurons","meshQualifierList":{"meshQualifier":[{"majorTopic_YN":"Y","abbreviation":"PH","qualifierName":"physiology"}]}},{"majorTopic_YN":"N","descriptorName":"Animals"},{"majorTopic_YN":"Y","descriptorName":"Association"},{"majorTopic_YN":"N","descriptorName":"Memory","meshQualifierList":{"meshQualifier":[{"majorTopic_YN":"Y","abbreviation":"PH","qualifierName":"physiology"}]}},{"majorTopic_YN":"N","descriptorName":"Algorithms"},{"majorTopic_YN":"Y","descriptorName":"Models, Neurological"},{"majorTopic_YN":"N","descriptorName":"Computer Simulation"}]},"subsetList":{"subset":[{"code":"IM","name":"Index Medicus"}]},"fullTextUrlList":{"fullTextUrl":[{"availability":"Subscription required","availabilityCode":"S","documentStyle":"doi","site":"DOI","url":"https://doi.org/10.1162/neco_a_01181"}]},"isOpenAccess":"N","inEPMC":"N","inPMC":"N","citedByCount":6,"hasReferences":"Y","hasTextMinedTerms":"Y","hasDbCrossReferences":"N","hasPDF":"N","hasBook":"N","hasSuppl":"N","hasLabsLinks":"N","hasData":"N","authMan":"N","epmcAuthMan":"N","nihAuthMan":"N","hasTMAccessionNumbers":"N","dateOfCompletion":"2019-12-09","dateOfCreation":"2019-03-19","dateOfRevision":"2019-12-17","electronicPublicationDate":"2019-03-18","firstPublicationDate":"2019-03-18","firstIndexDate":"2019-03-19","hasEvaluations":"N"}]}}
